title: Lesson 44 - Recommending the Correct Data Mapper Type per Business Need
description: Differentiate and recommend the correct Data Mapper type (Extract, Turbo Extract, Load, Transform) based on the specific business need.

questions.question: A scenario requires reading a small set of records with complex filters that span related objects. Which Data Mapper type is the correct recommendation?
questions.explanation: Complex filters and relationship traversal need the full SOQL feature set of Extract. Turbo Extract has a narrower feature set, Load writes, and Transform does not query.

questions.question: A scenario requires converting an external payload into a new JSON shape before sending it to another system, with no Salesforce write. Which type is correct?
questions.explanation: Transform reshapes data without persistence. Load writes, and Extract and Turbo Extract read, so only Transform fits a pure conversion.

questions.question: A scenario requires persisting records that may already exist, using a key field to decide insert versus update. Which Data Mapper type and operation are correct?
questions.explanation: Upsert is a Load operation that inserts or updates based on a key field. Extract and Turbo Extract read, and Transform does not persist, so only Load with upsert fits.
